title: HtmlSection
responsibility: Renders the native section element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlSection.attributes
inputs.description: Native section attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlSection.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native section element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlSection
outputs.description: The actual native section element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
